The main weakness is sectional ambition: the roofline and upper mass are still fairly generic and the void is modest, so the program fit is plausible but not yet strongly articulated as an active neighborhood-living section. Overall it is repairable and program-compatible, with decent resemblance to the supplied neighborhood references through central void, terracing potential, and upper/ground hierarchy.
